chunks: God will surely admit those who believe and do the right to gardens with rivers running by, where they will be decked in bracelets of gold and of pearls; and of silk will be their garments.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific rewards and adornments promised to believers in Paradise according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Hajj elaborates on the eternal reward for the faithful, emphasizing both spiritual purity and material splendor in Jannah. In Shia exegesis, the 'silk' (harir) and 'gold' are often interpreted not merely as luxury but as symbols of divine grace and the refined state of the soul, distinct from the rougher garments of the worldly life. The mention of flowing rivers underscores the permanence and vitality of this divine abode, reflecting the culmination of a life grounded in belief and righteous action.
